summary: Internal rewrite of the 'update check' API (POST /api/v*/checks/<uuid>): it no longer locks the check row in a transaction; it saves only the changed fields and returns 404 if the check was deleted mid-request. Same auth (API key + project match).

statements.why: Auth unchanged (@authorize + project_id check in hc/api/views.py update_check); save(update_fields=...) limits overwrites; no data-loss path introduced.

misses.what: The check-update API no longer holds a database lock while updating; if the check is deleted at the same moment, the API now returns 'not found' instead of erroring. Mostly internal, small edge-case behaviour.
